title: Austria Caught Between Stagnation and Austerity · 28 Aug
keywords: Austria, economy, inflation, GDP, stagnation, coalition, budget, fiscal policy, farm aid, tax policy, eurozone, cost of living, OeNB, WIFO, European Union
notes: Austria's economy flatlined in the second quarter of 2026 while inflation remains stubbornly elevated, squeezing households and exposing deep fault lines within the governing coalition. A clash over farm aid, tax policy, and budget discipline is testing the limits of fiscal restraint at a time when voters have little patience for further pain. The combined pressures place Austria among the clearest examples of a broader eurozone dilemma: how to protect citizens without breaking the rules that bind them.
